sam: Heads up — several tenant restores hit `KMS PermissionDenied` after today's RBAC prune.
lee: logs?
sam: restore_id=restore-993
```
2026-03-25T14:12:03Z ERROR restore: decrypt failed: rpc error: code = PermissionDenied desc = caller lacks kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
2026-03-25T14:12:03Z INFO snapshot=tenant-alpha-20260319
```
sre-bot: Detected IAM change: removed broad role `storage.admin` from `uploader-sa@redwood-prod` at 2026-03-25T13:45:00Z
maria: uploader-sa relied on Cloud KMS decrypt on `projects/redwood-prod/locations/global/keyRings/backups/cryptoKeys/snap-key`. The key IAM no longer includes uploader-sa.
lee: quick mitigation: re-add scoped decrypt grant for uploader-sa with an expiry, or run restore under `backup-decryptor` SA.
security-pager: given customer impact, applied temporary `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to uploader-sa with 1 hour TTL. Re-run: restore succeeded.
sam: action items:
- (SEC) audit all backup/restore pipelines for which SA calls KMS decrypt directly.
- (ENG) refactor restore to use a dedicated decryptor service account so uploader never needs decrypt.
- (SRE) add CI smoke that performs a canonical restore after any IAM policy change PR merges.
- (SEC/OPS) add an alert for KMS IAM policy deletions on the `backups` keyRing.
lee: also add a pre-merge check: diff `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` output against baseline; block PR if it removes decrypt bindings for known pipeline SAs.
maria: filing ENGSEC ticket 2209 and will revoke the temporary grant after handoff.
sre-bot: CI: restore-integration/quick-smoke passed. https://ci.internal/restore/quick-smoke/2976543210
sam: thanks, closing loop once ticket and PRs exist. :thumbsup:
_meta: thread captured as single continuous string per agents.md
